structured_output.conclusion: Two things are unresolved. First, a funding constraint: under the Knight loan, Synergy agreed not to add any other debt without paying out Knight first, and a default on any third-party debt automatically defaults the Knight loan. Whether Knight has consented to a new advance is unknown. Second, a settlement cash requirement: the 2024 schedules include $2,000,000 on the settlement loan (identified as Atrium by inference) and $600,000 on the March 27, 2024 supplier settlement, against approximately $2.0 million of reported cash. With $100,000 treated as unavailable and a $200,000 illustrative reserve, the sensitivity shows a requirement above reported cash of $900,000 if none of these amounts was paid after June 30, 2024, $250,000 if 25% was paid, and zero if 50% or more was paid. Synergy must also repay its Shopify debt by December 31, 2024. The Atrium litigation is settled, and its gain was non-cash. No lending action is taken. The review is incomplete: 12 debt, related-party and underwriting inventory items are escalated and block completion.
